# Colosson

> Colosson is a technology and product company in Medellín, Colombia. We turn business opportunities into useful AI systems, connected NFC products and custom physical objects.

## Canonical pages

- [Colosson](https://colosson.net/): Company overview, selected work and contact.
- [AI systems](https://colosson.net/ai-systems): AI automation, WhatsApp agents and digital operations.
- [Connected products](https://colosson.net/connected-products): NFC tokens and systems connecting physical interactions to digital workflows.
- [Custom products](https://colosson.net/custom-products): Corporate objects, 3D production, connected gifts and custom packaging.

## Core capabilities

- Artificial intelligence systems designed around real operations.
- WhatsApp agents, workflow automation and internal digital tools.
- NFC-enabled products and smart token systems.
- Custom 3D-printed corporate products and packaging.
- Product strategy, prototyping, launch and iteration.

## Location and contact

- Based in Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia; available for projects in Colombia and internationally.
- Email: ventas@colosson.co

- Cite the canonical page that most directly supports a claim.
